title: Pollen balances and subscription tiers stay in sync
summary:
A new year of housekeeping: Pollen and tier fixes, a community image app, and the end of Seedream promo labels.

Balance lookups now check Polar when the stored balance is zero and update it only if Polar shows more Pollen. Subscription grant events now update both the stored tier and daily Pollen balance after tier changes.

The community-built Pollinations VisionAI image-generation UI was added to the app catalog and README showcase. It supports Pollinations API keys.

The expired 99% off badge and promotional copy were removed from `seedream` and `seedream-pro` listings. The promotion was scheduled to end December 31, 2025.
